item.title: ▫️ Druzhkovka assault underway — infantry pushing forward Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, supported by unmanned systems teams,
item.description: ▫️ Druzhkovka assault underway — infantry pushing forward Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, supported by unmanned systems teams, have secured a foothold on the outskirts of Druzhkovka, and the infantry is already carrying out successful actions to storm the city . This was reported by the deputy company CO of the Group's separate unmanned systems regiment with call sign 'Artist'. The servicemen use a standard algorithm: first they cut off the enemy's supply routes, depriving him of ammunition and provisions, and then they deploy the maximum number of strike and reconnaissance drones. 'Today, drones are the most deterrent and the most important factor enabling our valiant infantry to advance,' the serviceman says. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 In Kharkov region, units of the Sever Group of Forces are shrinking the inner ring of the enemy's formations. As a result of active actions, Ozernoye (Kharkov region) was taken under control. 💥 In addition, the AFU units were hit in the 'pocket' of Malaya Volchya, Commissarovo, and Buzovo (Kharkov region). 🔥 On the outer ring , enemy manpower and hardware were neutralised close to Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolotnoye, and Olkhovatka (Kharkov region). ▪️ During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and four ground-based robotic systems. Assault groups thwarted two enemy attempts to break the ring close to Sliznevo and Dolzhanka (Kharkov region). 💥 In Kharkov region , units of two mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades of the AFU, one territorial defence brigade, and one national guard brigade have been hit near Lozovaya, Ternovaya, Doroshenkovo, Karasevka, Moskalevka, and Liptsy (Kharkov region). 🔥 In Sumy region , strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Partizanskoye, Chervonoye, Nikolskoye, Stepanovka, and Stetskovka (Sumy region). ▪️ In total, the enemy lost more than 205 troops, 22 motor vehicles, and one RADA RPS-42 counter-fire radar station in the Sever Group's area of responsibility. 📍 The Zapad Group's units
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29296

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
In Kharkov region, units of the Sever Group of Forces are shrinking the inner ring of the enemy's formations.
As a result of active actions, Ozernoye (Kharkov region) was taken under control.
💥
In addition,
the AFU units were hit in the 'pocket' of Malaya Volchya, Commissarovo, and Buzovo (Kharkov region).
🔥
On the outer ring
, enemy manpower and hardware were neutralised close to Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolotnoye, and Olkhovatka (Kharkov region).
▪️
During the day, the AFU losses amounted to up to 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two ATVs, and four ground-based robotic systems. Assault groups thwarted two enemy attempts to break the ring close to Sliznevo and Dolzhanka (Kharkov region).
💥
In Kharkov region
, units of two mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades of the AFU, one territorial defence brigade, and one national guard brigade have been hit near Lozovaya, Ternovaya, Doroshenkovo, Karasevka, Moskalevka, and Liptsy (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Partizanskoye, Chervonoye, Nikolskoye, Stepanovka, and Stetskovka (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 205 troops, 22 motor vehicles, and one RADA RPS-42 counter-fire radar station in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
📍
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Nizhsheye Solennoye, Chervony Oskol, Andreyevka, Monachinovka (Kharkov region), Glubokaya Makatikha, Karpovka, Raygorodok, and Starodubovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 200 troops, 17 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of five mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, three airmobile brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one air assault brigade of the AFU have been hit near Slavyansk, Gornyak, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Klinovoye, Vysokoivanovka, Nikolaypolye, and Krany Molochar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, two Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and one 122-mm D-30 howitzer.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one unmanned systems brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, three national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade close to Andreyevka, Novoroitskoye, Sergeyevka, Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), Maryevka, Novoandreyevka, Novopavlovka, and Kolona-Mezhevaya (Dnepropetrovsk region).

The AFU losses amounted to more than 425 troops, two Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, three electronic warfare stations, and one Israeli-made RADA RPS-42 counter-fire radar station.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued advancing into the depth of enemy defence.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two assault brigades, two air assault brigades, and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Samoylovka, Svetlaya Dolina, Barvinovka, Nikolskoye, Chervony Yar, Omelnik (Zaporozhye region), Podgavrilovka, and Pokrovskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region).

'
Tajikistan has been and remains a strategic partner of Russia.
'
🤝
Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov
took part in an official reception
marking the 35th anniversary of the independence of the Republic of Tajikistan.
'On behalf of the leadership of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation and on my own behalf, I sincerely congratulate you on the 35th anniversary of the state independence of the Republic of Tajikistan', Andrei Belousov said.
▫️
According to him, over these years
the republic has come a long way and has become a strong and independent state
that plays an important role in ensuring stability in the Central Asian region.
'Our peoples are bound by great heroic military past and a history of military feats. For us, the Republic of Tajikistan is not just a fraternal country. Victory in the Great Patriotic War forever defined us as comrades‑in‑arms,' he said.
▫️
The Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation noted that close military cooperation has been established between Russia and Tajikistan.
The Russian military base on the territory of the republic is in a state of readiness to combat external threats.
'We highly value Tajikistan’s contribution to strengthening regional and collective security.'﻿
💬
Andrei Belousov expressed confidence that the
allied relations between Russia and Tajikistan will continue to serve as a reliable foundation for peace and security in Central Asia.
'Tajikistan has been and remains a strategic partner of Russia,' he emphasised.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
